about_the_game:
• CATEGORY: TOWER OFFENSE, NO TOWER DEFENSE

Tower Offense is a subgenre of strategy games where players must attack and destroy enemy towers instead of defending their own. Unlike tower defense games, where defensive structures are placed to stop enemy waves, in a tower offense game, the goal is to strategically advance with units to overcome defenses and conquer the map.

Get ready for the battle of your life!

In Rush the Towers you face an unprecedented tactical challenge. With a limited squad (for example, four warriors and one archer) each decision is crucial to reach the end of the level.

Strategy, speed, and healing management are key to survival. Imagine that last warrior barely reaching the end with only 40 HP left and failing to destroy the enemy tower. That adrenaline will push you to improve every match!

Features:

  • 8 challenging levels

  • 3 types of warriors

  • Edge of your seat strategy

  • Healing and speed system

  • Immersive narrative -A continuously unfolding epic story revealed at the start of each level

*I also wanted to thank Pafund for the song Mysteries of an Ancient Church.*
